abandon.extension: 常考搭配 abandon oneself to 沉溺于；引申为放弃计划、习惯、权利

abroad.extension: 四六级常考 go abroad 出国；引申为广泛传播（如 news spread abroad）

accept.extension: 常考 accept responsibility 承担责任；引申为认可（accept an idea）

achieve.extension: achieve one's goal 实现目标；引申为经过努力获得成功

advantage.extension: take advantage of 利用；引申为 have an advantage over 胜过

affect.extension: 常与 effect 区分，affect v.影响；引申为打动（be deeply affected）

agreement.extension: reach an agreement 达成协议；引申为 in agreement with 与...一致

amount.extension: a large amount of +不可数名词；引申为总计达到（amount to）

analyze.extension: 名词 analysis；引申为用数据/逻辑分析问题

annual.extension: annual meeting 年会；引申为年度的（annual income）

apply.extension: apply for a job 求职；apply to 适用于；引申为投入精力（apply oneself to）

approach.extension: a new approach to 做某事的新方法；引申为春天/夜晚的临近

argue.extension: argue for/against 支持/反对；引申为 argue that 后接观点

aspect.extension: in every aspect 在各方面；雅思写作高频，用于替换 side

assume.extension: assume responsibility 承担责任；引申为假定条件（assuming that）

benefit.extension: for the benefit of 为了...的利益；引申为 benefit from 从...获益

budget.extension: within/over budget 在预算内/超出预算；引申为 budget airline 廉价航空

career.extension: career development 职业发展；引申为 career politician 职业政客

challenge.extension: face a challenge 面临挑战；引申为 challenge sb to do sth 挑战某人做某事

climate.extension: climate change 气候变化；引申为 political climate 政治氛围

communicate.extension: communicate with sb 与某人交流；引申为传达思想、感受

community.extension: international community 国际社会；引申为 communities of interest 利益共同体

concentrate.extension: concentrate on 专注于；引申为 concentrate one's efforts 集中精力

concern.extension: show concern about 对...表示关心；引申为 as far as sb is concerned 就某人而言

conclude.extension: to conclude 总而言之；引申为 conclude a deal 达成交易

consequence.extension: as a consequence 因此；引申为 take the consequences 承担后果

contribute.extension: contribute to 有助于/导致；引申为 contribute money 捐款

culture.extension: culture shock 文化冲击；引申为 corporate culture 企业文化

decline.extension: a decline in/of 在...方面下降；引申为 decline an invitation 婉拒邀请

demand.extension: in demand 有需求；引申为 on demand 一经要求
